# IconGems

> A free RESOURCE site where every asset lives on this domain: 3,448 MIT-licensed mascot logos from IP as Logo (1024px originals self-hosted, browser-side PNG export, ZIP batches) plus complete self-hosted snapshots of 131,751 open-source SVG icons from 29 famous libraries (Google Material Symbols, Microsoft Fluent, Tabler, Lucide, Phosphor, Font Awesome, Bootstrap, ByteDance IconPark…). Bilingual EN/ZH. Machine-readable end to end — search, SVG and PNG resolve with zero third-party requests.

## Quick start for agents

1. Mascot logos (MIT): manifest https://icongems.kuige.me/data/ipas-logos.json → preview `https://icongems.kuige.me/ipas/display/<key>.webp` → 1024px original `https://icongems.kuige.me/ipas/full/<key>.webp`
2. Icon names & chunk layout: `GET https://icongems.kuige.me/data/icon-index.json`
3. Icon SVG data: `GET https://icongems.kuige.me/icons/<prefix>.<k>.json` — Icon data is hash-chunked: for icon <prefix>:<name>, k = djb2_utf8(name) % K (K = byPrefix.<prefix>.k in the index; djb2_utf8: h=5381; for each UTF-8 byte b: h=(h*33+b) mod 2^32). Fetch https://icongems.kuige.me/icons/<prefix>.<k>.json and read .icons[<name>] = {body, width?, height?}; set-level width/height are the fallback dimensions. SVG = <svg xmlns viewBox="0 0 W H"> + body + </svg>.
4. Build SVG: `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 W H">{body}</svg>` (mono sets: add fill="currentColor" or your color)
5. Ship: MIT/Apache/ISC/CC0 assets need no attribution; CC BY 4.0 sets do. Full details in llms-full.txt.

## Site

- [IconGems](https://icongems.kuige.me/): the human interface — mascot library (default tab), local icon search, one-click SVG/PNG download, copy-ready React/Vue/HTML/CSS
- [llms-full.txt](https://icongems.kuige.me/llms-full.txt): this guide with the complete catalog inlined

## Mascot logos — IP as Logo (3,448, MIT, categories keyword-derived, fully self-hosted)

- Manifest (category + background color per logo): https://icongems.kuige.me/data/ipas-logos.json
- Previews (512px WebP, hosted here): https://icongems.kuige.me/ipas/display/<key>.webp
- Originals (1024px WebP with alpha, hosted here; PNG export converts in-browser): https://icongems.kuige.me/ipas/full/<key>.webp
- Source project: https://ipaslogo.com/ · skill: https://github.com/s1dashu/ip-as-logo-skill

## Avatar Studio (31 styles, generated client-side)

- Deep link: https://icongems.kuige.me/?avatar=<style>:<seed> — e.g. ?avatar=open-peeps:kuige
- Engine: DiceBear (vendored ESM, self-hosted, MIT) — styles render in the browser, no account, no upload
- License CC BY 4.0: adventurer, adventurer-neutral, big-ears, big-ears-neutral, big-smile, croodles, croodles-neutral, dylan, fun-emoji, micah, miniavs, personas, toon-head
- License CC0 1.0: glass, identicon, initials, lorelei, lorelei-neutral, notionists, notionists-neutral, open-peeps, pixel-art, pixel-art-neutral, rings, shapes, thumbs
- License Free for personal and commercial use: avataaars, avataaars-neutral, bottts, bottts-neutral
- License MIT: icons

## Self-hosted illustrations (250 files, CC0 / MIT)

- 3D Icons: 120 files, license CC0, by Vijay Verma — https://icongems.kuige.me/illus/<file>.png
- illlustrations.co: 130 files, license MIT, by Vijay Verma — https://icongems.kuige.me/illus/<file>.png
- Manifest: https://icongems.kuige.me/data/illus.json

## Free illustration libraries (16 off-site links at the end of the page — per-entry license)

- [unDraw](https://undraw.co/): free, no attribution ⚠ no AI training — Consistent-style illustrations with live color customizer (off-site)
- [Open Peeps](https://www.openpeeps.com/): CC0 — Hand-drawn people by Pablo Stanley (off-site)
- [Humaaans](https://humaaans.com/): CC0 — Mix-and-match human characters (off-site)
- [DiceBear](https://www.dicebear.com/): open source (per-style) — Avatar generator, dozens of styles (off-site)
- [Storyset](https://storyset.com/): free with attribution (Freepik) — Editable animated illustrations (off-site)
- [DrawKit](https://www.drawkit.com/): free with attribution (free tier) — Hand-drawn vector packs (off-site)
- [ManyPixels](https://www.manypixels.co/gallery): free, no attribution — Monocolor gallery with color picker (off-site)
- [3dicons](https://www.3dicons.com/): open source, free — Open-source 3D icons by Vijay Verma (off-site)
- [LottieFiles Free](https://lottiefiles.com/): mixed - check each asset — Large animated library (off-site)
- [IRA Design](https://iradesign.io/): MIT — Modular illustration builder by Creative Tim (off-site)
- [Lukasz Adam](https://lukaszadam.com/illustrations): CC0 — Free miscellaneous vectors (off-site)
- [absurd.design](https://absurd.design/): free with attribution (free tier) — Surreal line-art (off-site)
- [Ouch! by Icons8](https://icons8.com/ouch): free with link — Vector & 3D illustrations (off-site)
- [Doodle Ipsum](https://doodleipsum.com/): free (Blush license) — Doodle API by Blush (off-site)
- [Shapefest](https://shapefest.com/): free for commercial use — Large 3D shape library (off-site)
- [illlustrations.co](https://illlustrations.co/): open source, free — Open-source illustrations (off-site)

## Local data endpoints (all on this domain, CORS-open, no key)

```
GET /data/icon-index.json            # all icon names grouped by prefix + chunk layout
GET /icons/<prefix>.<k>.json         # SVG bodies, hash chunk (see recipe in quick start)
GET /data/ipas-logos.json            # mascot manifest: {logos: {<key>: [category, bg]}}
GET /ipas/display/<key>.webp         # mascot 512px preview
GET /ipas/full/<key>.webp            # mascot 1024px original
Base: https://icongems.kuige.me
```

## Deep links

- Search results: https://icongems.kuige.me/?q=<term>  ·  Browse one set: https://icongems.kuige.me/?set=<id>

## Licensing

- No attribution: MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, CC0 — all mascot logos + most icon sets above
- Attribution required: CC BY 4.0 (Solar, Font Awesome Free, Twemoji, Codicons)
- Illustrations: per-entry, see catalog (off-site links). unDraw prohibits AI/ML training use.
- Always verify on the source site before shipping.
